existing_derivations.title: Unconventional superconductivity in magic-angle graphene superlattices
existing_derivations.abstract: The magic angle in twisted bilayer graphene occurs when the Fermi velocity vanishes, creating flat bands. Derived from tight-binding model of moiré superlattice.
